versions.name: Quivira Scout Ranch

features.note: The camp surrounds Murray Gill Lake.
Water skiing and tubing behind camp boats.
A fleet of Sea Doo personal watercraft on the lake.
A fishing and fly-fishing crew program, plus fish and wildlife management.
Guided rides culminating in a twenty-two-mile round trip off camp.
An introductory backpacking trek based on the Backpacking merit badge.
Each older-Scout crew takes at least one outpost away from main camp.
A technology area with a 3D printer, game design, and animation.
Older-Scout crews cook in camp or on trek for some meals.
The OAKS program covers rank fundamentals for new Scouts.
HIGH Q, a crew-based adventure week for older Scouts.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA and Venturing resident summer camp located in Sedan, Kansas.
